name: Mosi-oa-Tunya / Victoria Falls
subtitle: A natural property on the UNESCO World Heritage List since 1989.

parts.text: UNESCO describes the property in these words: “These are among the most spectacular waterfalls in the world. The Zambezi River, which is more than 2 km wide at this point, plunges noisily down a series of basalt gorges and raises an iridescent mist that can be seen more than 20 km away.”
